user_story: As a user, I want to be able to submit a contact form on the Practice Software Testing website so that I can reach out for support or inquiries. The form should validate inputs to ensure that required fields are filled out correctly before submission.
script: describe('Contact Form Validation', () => { it('should submit the form successfully with valid inputs', () => { cy.visit('https://practicesoftwaretesting.com/contact'); cy.get('#first_name').type('John'); cy.get('#last_name').type('Doe'); cy.get('#email').type('john.doe@example.com'); cy.get('#subject').select('Customer service'); cy.get('#message').type('This is a test message.'); cy.get('input[data-test="contact-submit"]').click(); cy.get('div[data-test="notification-bar"]').should('contain', 'View the Documentation for this application.'); }); it('should show validation errors when required fields are empty', () => { cy.visit('https://practicesoftwaretesting.com/contact'); cy.get('input[data-test="contact-submit"]').click(); cy.get('#first_name').should('have.class', 'ng-invalid'); cy.get('#last_name').should('have.class', 'ng-invalid'); cy.get('#email').should('have.class', 'ng-invalid'); cy.get('#message').should('have.class', 'ng-invalid'); }); });

user_story: As a user, I want to log into the application using my credentials so that I can access the secure area. Acceptance Criteria: 1. The login form must contain an input field with id 'username' for entering the username. 2. The login form must contain an input field with id 'password' for entering the password. 3. Upon entering valid credentials (username 'tomsmith' and password 'SuperSecretPassword!') and clicking the 'Login' button, I should be redirected to the secure area. 4. If I enter invalid credentials, I should see an error message in the 'flash-messages' div.
script: describe('Login Form Tests', () => { it('should log in with valid credentials', () => { cy.visit('https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/login'); cy.get('#username').type('tomsmith'); cy.get('#password').type('SuperSecretPassword!'); cy.get('button.radius').click(); cy.url().should('include', '/secure'); }); it('should show error message with invalid credentials', () => { cy.visit('https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/login'); cy.get('#username').type('invalidUser'); cy.get('#password').type('invalidPassword'); cy.get('button.radius').click(); cy.get('#flash-messages').should('contain', 'Your username is invalid!'); }); });

user_story: As a user, I want to be able to interact with checkboxes on the checkbox form so that I can select or deselect options as needed. Acceptance Criteria: 1. The form with id 'checkboxes' should be present on the page. 2. There should be two checkboxes available for selection, represented by 'input' elements of type 'checkbox'.
script: describe('Checkbox Form', () => { it('should allow the user to check the first checkbox', () => { cy.visit('https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/checkboxes'); cy.get('input[type="checkbox"]').first().check(); cy.get('input[type="checkbox"]').first().should('be.checked'); }); it('should allow the user to uncheck the second checkbox', () => { cy.visit('https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/checkboxes'); cy.get('input[type="checkbox"]').last().uncheck(); cy.get('input[type="checkbox"]').last().should('not.be.checked'); }); });

user_story: As a user, I want to be able to add and remove elements dynamically on the page so that I can test the functionality of adding and removing elements as needed.
script: describe('Add and Remove Elements', () => { it('should add an element when the button is clicked', () => { cy.visit('https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/add_remove_elements/'); cy.get('button').contains('Add Element').click(); cy.get('#elements').children().should('have.length', 1); }); it('should remove an element when the remove button is clicked', () => { cy.visit('https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/add_remove_elements/'); cy.get('button').contains('Add Element').click(); cy.get('#elements').children().should('have.length', 1); cy.get('#elements').children().first().click(); cy.get('#elements').children().should('have.length', 0); }); });

user_story: As a user, I want to view sortable data tables so that I can easily find and organize information. Acceptance Criteria: 1. The page should display a table with the ID 'table1' and class 'tablesorter'. 2. The table should have headings including 'Last Name', 'First Name', 'Email', 'Due', 'Web Site', and 'Action'. 3. The page should contain links with text 'edit' and 'delete' for each entry in the table.
script: describe('Sortable Data Tables', () => { it('should display sortable data tables', () => { cy.visit('https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/tables'); cy.get('#table1').should('exist'); cy.get('#table1').find('th').should('contain', 'Last Name'); cy.get('#table1').find('th').should('contain', 'First Name'); cy.get('#table1').find('th').should('contain', 'Email'); cy.get('#table1').find('th').should('contain', 'Due'); cy.get('#table1').find('th').should('contain', 'Web Site'); cy.get('#table1').find('th').should('contain', 'Action'); }); it('should not find a non-existing table', () => { cy.visit('https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/tables'); cy.get('#non-existing-table').should('not.exist'); }); });

user_story: As a user, I want to interact with JavaScript alert dialogs so that I can confirm actions and receive notifications. Acceptance Criteria: 1. When I click the button with text 'Click for JS Alert', an alert should appear with the message 'I am a JS Alert'. 2. When I click the button with text 'Click for JS Confirm', an alert should appear asking for confirmation. 3. When I click the button with text 'Click for JS Prompt', an alert should appear that allows me to input text.
script: describe('JavaScript Alerts', () => { it('should display JS Alert and accept it', () => { cy.visit('https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/javascript_alerts'); cy.contains('button', 'Click for JS Alert').click(); cy.on('window:alert', (txt) => { expect(txt).to.eq('I am a JS Alert'); }); cy.get('#result').should('have.text', 'You successfully clicked an alert'); }); it('should display JS Confirm and cancel it', () => { cy.visit('https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/javascript_alerts'); cy.contains('button', 'Click for JS Confirm').click(); cy.on('window:confirm', () => false); cy.get('#result').should('have.text', 'You clicked: Cancel'); }); });
